nativeTypeDifference: Chromium preserves unsanitized pristine value attributes when range/color switch to default/default-on mode. HTML type-change step1 instead copies the current nonempty value, irrespective of the dirty flag.
nativeFocusDifference: Chromium clears the focused input when type becomes hidden without blur. HTML update-the-rendering instead runs focusing steps when the focused area ceases to be focusable; the retained element receives blur.
nativeResetDifference: Chromium connected controls collapse selection to the end on value-changing reset. The HTML input reset algorithm changes the value; the relevant-value-change algorithm preserves its previous range and direction, clamping only positions beyond the new end. Detached native controls already follow this clamp behavior.
